blocks.title: Computer programming
blocks.text: Computer programming is the process of creating a set of instructions that tell a computer how to perform a task, written in a programming language the computer can understand and execute.

It is like giving directions to a friend on how to reach your house: you must be clear and precise so your friend does not get lost. In the same way a program gives clear and precise instructions to the computer to complete specific tasks.

blocks.prompt: Why must program instructions be clear and precise?
blocks.explanation: Because the computer follows them exactly; a vague or wrong instruction, like wrong directions to a friend, leads to the wrong result.

items: Programming: writing precise instructions in a language the computer can execute, like clear directions to a friend.
